scope: Six previously open Peah positions; lexical follow-up only
method: Public web search located an actual Ma’agarim PMain text page. Opened page and followed its existing next-page link; then fetched those exact public HTML URLs and read word-bound erec0/srs0/yhd0/hera0 attributes. No guessed API, no browser session, no morphology mutations.
limitations: No separately labelled genus, number or state fields were found among the quoted word attributes. Such features are not certified as Ma’agarim morphology.
The corpus text and word-specific lemma metadata come from the Kaufmann witness; this is not a comparison of independent manuscripts.
Vocalization or semantic peculiarities are preserved explicitly.
Quoted contexts are short evidence excerpts, not a corpus export.
